about:
House of Breakers is a wholesale electrical equipment and supply distributor based in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company was founded in 1976 and is locally owned and operated by Carlos A. Chandarlis and Jacqueline F. Guerra. It began as a supplier of new and obsolete electrical parts, focusing on providing low wholesale prices to customers nationwide.

The company stocks over 3,000 parts, including circuit breakers, electrical panels, fuses, meter bases, and mounting hardware. It sources products from manufacturers such as Square D, Siemens, GE, Cutler Hammer, and Zinsco. House of Breakers operates a facility at 4689 S Valley View Blvd and offers 24-hour emergency contact for after-hours needs. The business emphasizes saving obsolete parts from waste, describing its approach as "green."

House of Breakers serves residential, commercial, and industrial customers across the United States. Its client base includes contractors, maintenance departments, and facility managers who require both current-production and hard-to-find obsolete components. The company provides bilingual support in English and Spanish.

The founders established the business to address the difficulty of locating obsolete electrical parts at reasonable prices. The company differentiates itself by specializing in both new and obsolete inventory, maintaining a licensed, insured, and bonded operation, and offering a low-price guarantee on wholesale orders.
